skills.skill_desc:
For 8s after casting a skill, Odette's next Basic Attack gains extra range and bounces between enemies (or an enemy and herself), dealing 144-200<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> per hit.

Odette's skills also trigger this effect on hit (up to 3 stacks).

Odette releases a magic swan in the target direction, dealing 300<font color="62f8fe"> (+150% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies hit and slowing them by 30% for 2s.

Odette releases a group of magic orbs in the target direction, dealing 250<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to the first enemy hit and immobilizing them for 1.5s.

When an orb hits an enemy, it creates another orb that attacks a nearby enemy, prioritizing enemy heroes, dealing 250<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and immobilizing them for 1.5s.

Odette channels a dance, gaining a 1200<font color="62f8fe"> (+150% Total Magic Power)</font> shield and dealing up to 2000<font color="62f8fe"> (+750% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to nearby enemies in a large area for 5s. During this time, her Movement Speed is reduced by 40%, but she can move freely.

<font color="A4AAC7">Use again to cancel. Only high-level control effects can interrupt this skill.</font>
